chunks: Muhammad ibn Ya'qub from Muhammad ibn Yahya from Ahmad ibn Muhammad from Ibn Mahbub from Muhammad ibn al-Mustanir from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
"Whoever has intercourse with his wife while in his state of ihram, he is not permitted to depart (from Mina) in the first departure."

key_terms.إِحْرَامِهِ: State of ritual consecration for Hajj or Umrah
key_terms.اَلنَّفْرِ اَلْأَوَّلِ: The first departure from Mina (on the 12th of Dhu al-Hijjah)

ai.seo_question: What is the penalty for having intercourse during ihram in Hajj?
ai.summary: This hadith from *Tahdhib al-Ahkam* specifies that sexual intercourse during ihram invalidates the pilgrim's right to perform the 'first departure' (al-nafar al-awwal) from Mina on the 12th of Dhu al-Hijjah, a ruling derived from the Quranic prohibition of 'sexual relations' (rafath) in the Hajj verses. In Shia jurisprudence, this is often interpreted as a specific penalty (kaffarah) or a restriction on the ritual sequence, distinguishing it from the general prohibition of intercourse which requires a full sacrifice. The narration highlights the strictness of maintaining ritual purity and the consequences of major acts that break the sanctity of the pilgrimage state.
